title: Ornàment Web Design, Psychology, Color & Conversion Intelligence System

principles.name: 60-30-10 Dark Luxury Architecture
principles.ratio: 60% Base Canvas, 30% Structural Elevation/Borders, 10% High-Energy Accent
principles.theory: Never use pure pitch black (#000) or pure white (#fff) on large areas. Pure contrast causes optical vibration and eye fatigue. Use layered obsidian/zinc tones with translucent borders.

champagne_gold.meaning: Exclusivity, luxury, bespoke craft, premium heritage

laws.principle: Decision time increases logarithmically with the number and complexity of choices.
laws.cro_rule: Strict One-Primary-CTA rule above the fold. Highlight a single 'Most Popular' pricing tier. Use progressive disclosure on forms.

laws.principle: Target acquisition time is a function of distance and target size.
laws.cro_rule: CTAs must have a minimum 48px touch target height with generous horizontal padding (px-6 py-3) and thumb-zone accessibility.

laws.principle: System feedback must occur within 400ms to preserve user immersion and cognitive flow.
laws.cro_rule: Every button must have instant active:scale-[0.98] depress states, hover illumination, and skeleton loaders for async actions.

laws.principle: Users scan web pages in an F-pattern for content-dense text and a Z-pattern for visual landing pages.
laws.cro_rule: Place high-trust brand logo top-left, primary action top-right, core hook center, and conversion CTA at the terminal vertex of the Z.

rules.name: 5-Second Value Proposition Test
rules.rule: Clarify WHAT the product does, FOR WHOM, and WHY it matters in under 5 seconds above the fold.

rules.name: Proof Stacking
rules.rule: Place customer logos, real metrics ('99.99% uptime', '10k+ engineers'), and verified testimonials directly under the primary CTA to eliminate hesitation.

rules.name: The Product-as-Demo Shift (2026)
rules.rule: Replace static screenshot images with live interactive components, real simulated code previews, or dynamic telemetry cards.

bento_grid.definition: Asymmetric multi-cell grid inspired by Japanese lunch boxes.
bento_grid.usage: 2-column span for primary flagship capability, 1-column span for supporting metrics and live telemetry.
bento_grid.styling: rounded-2xl bg-zinc-900/40 border border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all

typographic_scales.perfect_fourth: 1.333 multiplier (optimal for high-impact marketing & luxury display)
